sources.entry: create-dmg - Create a good-looking DMG for your macOS app in seconds. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/sindresorhus/create-dmg) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A command-line tool that builds a good-looking macOS .dmg disk image for distributing an app outside the Mac App Store.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Node.js CLI, installed globally with npm, that packages a macOS app into a DMG with a designed layout. It provides options to overwrite an existing DMG, leave the version number out of the filename, set the code signing identity (automatic by default), and set the DMG title. If a license.txt or license.rtf file is in the working directory, it is added as a software license agreement shown when the image opens, and the image is not mounted until the user accepts it. The README says the tool is intentionally opinionated and simple, with few options. The README is truncated in places, so the full option list and any further details are not visible here.
use_cases: Packaging a macOS app as a DMG for direct download
Creating a styled installer disk image for users
Adding a software license agreement to a DMG
Automating DMG creation in a release script
notable: Produces a good-looking DMG with no design work required
Intentionally opinionated and simple, with few options
Automatic code signing identity detection, with an option to set it manually
Optional license agreement shown before the image mounts
caveats: Targets macOS apps; the DMG format is specific to macOS
The README states the tool is intentionally opinionated and does not plan to add many options
keywords: distribute app outside mac app store
